CLINICAL FEATURES OF PULMONARY TUBERCULOSIS
Clinical Features
Symptoms
- Persistent cough
- Weight loss
- Drenching night sweats
- Chest pain (dull or pleuritic)
- Haemoptysis
- Anorexia
Signs:
- Physical examination may be normal
- Crepitations usually in the upper zone (earliest physical sign)
- Physical signs of consolidation, cavitation and fibrosis develop later
- Pallor and finger clubbing
- Erythema nodusum and phlyctenular conjunctivitis (Primary PTB)
